description: Defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelDetailViewLink class, a custom widget for rendering links in subpanel detail views within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. The class manages the creation of hyperlink elements to detail views of related records, handling various module and record-specific logic.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelDetailViewLink
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetField that generates dynamic links to related record detail views in subpanels, with special handling for email modules and access control.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML anchor tag linking to a related record's detail view, based on the provided layout definition array. Handles special cases for email modules and incorporates access control checks.
